metadata.architecture_assumption: Manual panels and beams; optional user preference question pending. No winch or off-machine parking assumed.
metadata.cuts_per_bar: three 397 mm pieces, total residual 29 mm for kerfs/end trim
metadata.procedure: Remove stock, clean and dry. Park gantry rear and isolate drives. Remove/store 24 spoil screws and six boards, 16 panel clamps and six panels, then eight beam bolts and four beams. Fill rear storage locations before front locations. Reverse for router mode. Map seats and re-probe after conversion.
metadata.cabinet_service: Reinstall bed and spoilboards to empty the front and left storage racks before opening controls cabinet. Fixed holders remain outside door width.
release_holds: Full ordered handling sweeps with already stored parts and fingers/clearances

Seat welding, frame and complete tool-loop rigidity qualification
Actual aluminum inventory/alloy and shop machining capability
